messages:
Maria Ops: FYI — AP at Acme called. Card declined and they've received a service suspension notice. They say they already uploaded a PO but our invoice doesn't show it. looping in collections.
Alex Collections: Ok — what's the invoice id / PO number?
Maria Ops: INV-2026-00123, they claim PO-98765. I have a PDF from their AP.
Samir Support: Quick check: payment attempt failed for INV-2026-00123, card ending 4242, decline_code=card_declined. Looks like we retried once.
billing-bot: Payment attempt failed for customer cust_8234 on invoice INV-2026-00123 — decline_code: card_declined
Emily Sales: Customer is on a committed plan. They need the service restored ASAP — they prefer invoicing to PO vs card.
Alex Collections: Two tracks: (A) manual reconcile: attach their PO to the invoice and resend to AP; (B) keep suspension until we receive payment or signed net terms. Need finance/legal ok for temporary reactivation.
Legal: We can't lift without either received payment, signed net-30 terms, or a formal written assurance from their AP. Risk of non-payment if we reactivate on just a PO PDF.
Maria Ops: AP contact is liz.billing@acme.com. I've uploaded the PDF to the ticket and forwarded to billing@redwood.com. The PO header includes VAT ID and billing address.
Samir Support: Repro notes: customer added PO via UI; our ingestion pipeline did not populate invoice.po_number for invoices generated via async billing job. Suspect mapping bug in webhook handler.
Alex Collections: @engineering FYI — can you confirm ingestion mapping? Short-term we can manually add PO to the invoice record in Stripe/DB and resend.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-00123 resent to liz.billing@acme.com (attachment: INV-2026-00123.pdf, VAT breakdown included)
Emily Sales: I'll offer a one-time courtesy waiver of the late fee if they pay within 48h or provide a signed net-30 with PO. That should get them unblocked.
Alex Collections: Approve waive fee contingent on either: cleared payment OR signed terms + PO on file. If they pay by wire, we can reconcile and restore immediately.
Samir Support: Process for restore: 1) Confirm payment cleared OR 2) Confirm signed net-30 + PO attached. Then I can flip service status to active and notify dev teams. I will not restore on verbal promise.
Maria Ops: I've asked AP to confirm payment ETA and re-sent the invoice with PO reference. Sent copy to @Emily Sales for the courtesy offer.
Alex Collections: If they push back and claim suspension was in error, escalate to me and legal. Keep ticket with timestamps and emails. Do not reverse-chargebacks or credits until legal approves.
Maria Ops: Noted. I'll keep thread updated. Thanks all. :pray:
